Subject: Disarming EU Treaty Bodies via RM Constitution Art 4 & 8

CoreArguments.Description: Invalidates ECHR precedents that treat fundamental rights as tradable commodities generated via corporate AI protocols and data manipulation.
Direct application of UN Charter and UDHR overrides European bureaucratic jurisprudence and procedural limits (like Art 85 CPC RM).
Demands total restitution, rejecting the ECHR's limited 'just satisfaction' model as fundamentally unconstitutional.
